data.one_liner: CLI tool for Dart package maintenance to automate pubspec.yaml and CHANGELOG.md updates.
data.what_it_does: Cider is a command-line utility that automatically increments versions, sets package versions, and manages changelog entries in Dart projects. It helps automate release workflows by formatting changelogs according to Keep a Changelog standards and generating diff links.
use_when: You want to automate version bumping and changelog maintenance via CLI or CI scripts.
Your project follows Semantic Versioning and the Keep a Changelog format.
avoid_when: You need an in-code Dart library API rather than a standalone CLI tool.
Your project uses a custom or non-standard changelog structure.
strengths: Provides robust version bumping rules including support for pre-releases, build metadata, and breaking changes.
Automatically links diffs and handles changelog releases cleanly.
weaknesses: Strictly expects a specific changelog format and structure.
Operates as an external CLI tool rather than a package-integrated programmatic API.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using `dart pub global activate cider` and optionally configure link templates in pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate cider
cider bump minor
cider log added 'New feature support'
cider release
